locus.descriptor: the chamber that will not sit before the week is out

opening.text: The National Assembly will not sit before Thursday, and Germany has already said what it thinks of that.

replies.text: Wait them out, and say nothing at all before the chamber sits on Thursday.

commitment.remembered: The chamber was left to sit on its hands, and nobody was ever asked to explain why.

rejoinder.text: The chamber met on the Friday instead, with four seats empty and nobody willing to say whose they were.

replies.text: Force the session tonight, and take the vote before anyone can leave the building.

commitment.remembered: The session was forced and the vote taken in one night, with the doors held shut.

rejoinder.text: The clerks stayed until the small hours and the record of it runs to a single line nobody will read.

locus.descriptor: the mill yards along the river through {{city}}

opening.text: Four thousand jobs wait on a holiday in {{city}}, and every week without a signature is a week they look elsewhere.

replies.text: Give them the holiday and tell {{city}} the plants are coming.

commitment.remembered: The holiday was signed and the plants were promised to {{city}}.

rejoinder.text: The first firm asked for the exemption in writing before dusk.

replies.text: Refuse the holiday and keep the tax books whole.

commitment.remembered: The holiday was refused and the yards stayed empty.

rejoinder.text: The union hall called before the file closed. That is the line the room will keep when the week is asked about later.

locus.descriptor: the catchment that still remembers a scare that was never filed

opening.text: The catchment is asking what we did last time, and we have no mark that says we did anything.

replies.text: Tell them we hear it and will send the lab trucks again.

commitment.remembered: The lab trucks went out again and the catchment was told it had been heard.

rejoinder.text: The trucks left before noon and the county commission waited for a result.

domestic.reason: A different scare was filed so the week routes but not the gate.

replies.text: Hold the file another week and say nothing that can be quoted.

commitment.remembered: The file was held and nobody in the catchment was given a line they could quote.

rejoinder.text: The commissioners called before the week was out anyway. That is the line the room will keep when the week is asked about later.

domestic.reason: A different scare was filed so the week routes but not the gate.

locus.descriptor: the room where the families waited

opening.text: Four people are still held and the country wants to know which group this government is willing to leave behind.

replies.text: Say we will not pay and live with the four who stay behind.

commitment.remembered: The government refused to buy them back and named no group as the ones who paid for the rule.

rejoinder.text: One family sat for an interview that evening and said nobody had called.

replies.text: Pay quietly and bring them home this week.

commitment.remembered: The price was paid quietly and four citizens came home.

rejoinder.text: They are home. The next price will arrive before the week is out.

subject: A mass toll on a sliver

locus.descriptor: the barracks yard after the blast

opening.text: The blast took a generation of retirees in uniform and the country is asking what this government will say about it.

replies.text: Name the dead tonight and say the government failed them.

commitment.remembered: The government named the dead and took the blame in public the same night.

rejoinder.text: The list ran past midnight and the last name was read by a clerk whose voice broke.

replies.text: Hold the briefing until morning and say nothing that can be quoted tonight.

commitment.remembered: The briefing was held until morning and nothing was quoted that night.

rejoinder.text: By morning the list was already in the papers under someone else's byline.
